blockers.description: SSH Agent toggle in Settings crashes pwmgr-app.exe with 0xc0000409 (stack-buffer-overrun/fastfail), crash then repeats on every launch until ssh_agent_enabled is manually reset to false in ~/.pwmgr/config.json
blockers.workaround: Hand-edit config.json's ssh_agent_enabled field to false, then relaunch normally. Root cause unfixed in source. This is why D2 has not been attempted this session.

blockers.description: Make UI's item list ('All Items' and everything derived from it) goes stale after Restore Backup's forced relogin and does not refresh again — reproducibly, across relogins and full app relaunches — until a genuine Add Item call forces a refetch. Confirmed the backend itself is correct throughout (verified against Classic UI on the same vault).
blockers.workaround: Add any new item to force a refetch; the list then shows the true state correctly.

blockers.description: Login screen's 'Unlock with Windows Hello' button is gated on the Master password field having non-empty content, not on username+enrollment state — so a user must type something into the password field (defeating the point) before the biometric option even appears.
blockers.workaround: Type any character into Master password first, then the button appears and biometric verification works correctly and ignores whatever was typed.
